_comment: Per-hero skill trees (issue #25, scripts/skill_tree.gd, screen scripts/skill_tree_view.gd). Each field hero has a root node and two branches of five nodes, bought in order with Skill Points (points: per_level for every level past 1). A branch's first node needs the root; every other node needs the one before it. The last node of each branch is its capstone: a hero can hold only one capstone. bond: the hero's bond rank with Ash (data/bonds.json) the node needs. bonds: [rank, count] for heroes without a bond (Ash): that many bonds at that rank or higher. effects: stats (added like gear, keys as in Progress.STAT_ORDER), abilities ({ability id: {add, mult, set, set_missing}} applied after the Ink tier, see SkillTree.mod_ability), perks (passives, every key is handled in scripts/tree_perks.gd, see PERKS there), ai ({focus: wounded | marked | leader_threat | elite}: who the hero goes for when the ally AI drives it). respec: unlearning a whole tree costs base + per_point Gilt for every point spent, in Hollowmark or at the Command Table (not on a mission).

root.name: First Draft
root.flavor: Spat out of the Blank with nothing. Something to start from.

branches.name: Author
branches.blurb: Write the party back into the world: bigger mends, more Ink, nobody stays down.

nodes.name: Generous Hand
nodes.desc: Rewrite heals 4 more and reaches 12 px further.
nodes.flavor: Ash writes in a wider hand than they need to.

nodes.name: Footnotes
nodes.desc: Ink refills 0.15 a second faster (about a third quicker).
nodes.flavor: Small print, endlessly.

nodes.name: Second Draft
nodes.desc: Rewrite also gives every ally it touches 3 Ink.
nodes.flavor: The second draft is always kinder.

nodes.name: Marginalia
nodes.desc: Allies within 70 px of Ash take 10% less damage.
nodes.flavor: People stand closer to Ash than they mean to. The Blank notices.

nodes.name: Author's Hand
nodes.desc: Rewrite is 2 s quicker to come back and its shield is half again as strong. Fallen allies near Ash get up twice as fast.
nodes.flavor: Nobody dies in Ash's chapters. Not on purpose, anyway.

branches.name: Editor
branches.blurb: Cut what should not be there: marks, sharper edges, techs that end things.

nodes.name: Sharp Nib
nodes.desc: +2 Damage.
nodes.flavor: A quill-knife is mostly knife.

nodes.name: Red Pen
nodes.desc: Strikethrough marks everything it cuts: they take 25% more damage from everyone for 4 s.
nodes.flavor: Circled, underlined, queried.

nodes.name: Cut Copy
nodes.desc: Strikethrough comes back 1.5 s sooner, and every kill Ash lands gives back 2 Ink.
nodes.flavor: Every line removed is a line you don't have to read.

nodes.name: Kill Your Darlings
nodes.desc: Ash deals 30% more damage to enemies under 35% HP.
nodes.flavor: Finish it. Do not admire it.

nodes.name: Final Cut
nodes.desc: Charged techs hit 20% harder, and Strikethrough stuns what it cuts for 0.5 s more.
nodes.flavor: The End, in a clean hand.

root.name: Clause One: Payment
root.flavor: Payment first. Everything else is negotiable.

branches.name: Bodyguard
branches.blurb: Clause four, taken seriously: Bran stands in front of the client and takes the hits meant for them.

nodes.name: Client Protection
nodes.desc: Hold the Line reaches 20 px further, and as an ally Bran uses it as soon as one enemy closes on the leader.
nodes.flavor: The rider nobody reads until they need it.

nodes.name: Thick Hide
nodes.desc: Armor blocks 8% more of every hit, and knockback moves him half as far.
nodes.flavor: Bran is not pushed. Bran is occasionally relocated.

nodes.name: Clause Four
nodes.desc: 30% of the damage aimed at allies within 56 px lands on Bran instead. As an ally he goes for whatever is attacking the leader.
nodes.flavor: Guard the client. It's tattooed. It tightens if he doesn't.

nodes.name: Hold the Bill
nodes.desc: Hold the Line lasts 2 s longer and gives Bran a 15-point shield.
nodes.flavor: The bill comes later. He makes sure there is a later.

nodes.name: Paid in Blood
nodes.desc: Once a mission, a blow that would drop Bran leaves him on 1 HP instead. Enemies that hit him take 20% of it back.
nodes.flavor: Breach of contract is not an option. It is in the contract.

branches.name: Turncoat
branches.blurb: Bran works for whoever pays best, and he tells you so: harder hits, bounties and looking after number one.

nodes.name: Hazard Pay
nodes.desc: +2 Damage.
nodes.flavor: Danger money, paid in advance, spent in advance.

nodes.name: Itemised Violence
nodes.desc: Every kill Bran lands is worth 2 Gilt, brought home with the rest of the loot.
nodes.flavor: One Nibbler, removed. Two Gilt. Receipt on request.

nodes.name: Cleave Clause
nodes.desc: Cleave swings 20 degrees wider and heals Bran for 30% of the damage it deals.
nodes.flavor: Self-preservation is a clause too. Clause one, technically.

nodes.name: Renegotiation
nodes.desc: Below 40% HP Bran hits 30% harder.
nodes.flavor: Terms change when the client is bleeding. So does the price.

nodes.name: Highest Bidder
nodes.desc: Kills refill Bran's gauge at once, and 15% of his hits land half again as hard. As an ally he picks off the wounded first.
nodes.flavor: He told you he would sell you out if outbid. Nobody has outbid you. Yet.

branches.name: Matron
branches.blurb: Her medicines: bigger heals, sooner, shields on top, and everybody back on their feet. Billed, naturally.

nodes.name: Warm Hands
nodes.desc: Every heal she gives (Poultice Toss and her passive poultice) is 15% bigger.
nodes.flavor: Warmed on the cauldron. Don't ask what else is in the cauldron.

nodes.name: House Call
nodes.desc: Poultice Toss reaches 16 px further, and as an ally she throws it as soon as anyone nearby drops under 70% HP.
nodes.flavor: She doesn't wait to be asked. She waits to be paid.

nodes.name: Thick Broth
nodes.desc: Poultice Toss adds an 8-point shield for 5 s to everyone it heals.
nodes.flavor: It sets like glue. That is the point.

nodes.name: Smelling Salts
nodes.desc: Fallen allies near her get up twice as fast.
nodes.flavor: One sniff and the dead sit up and complain about the smell.

nodes.name: Account Settled
nodes.desc: Her passive poultice comes 30% more often, and every Poultice Toss bills 3 Gilt, brought home with the loot.
nodes.flavor: Mother Gristle has never lost a patient. She has lost several debtors.

branches.name: Poisoner
branches.blurb: Her poisons are the same bottles: venom on the ladle, scalds that linger, and things that stop getting up.

nodes.name: Same Bottle
nodes.desc: Her swings poison: 2 damage a second for 4 s.
nodes.flavor: Medicine is a matter of dose. So is the other thing.

nodes.name: Scalding
nodes.desc: Scald deals 4 more and poisons for 3 a second.
nodes.flavor: Broth, with notes of nightshade.

nodes.name: Bitter Draught
nodes.desc: She deals 25% more damage to poisoned enemies.
nodes.flavor: It works better if they're already feeling poorly.

nodes.name: Black Label
nodes.desc: Her poison bites 2 a second harder, and every kill she lands gives her 3 Ink.
nodes.flavor: The bottle with the skull on it. She drew the skull herself.

nodes.name: Last Rites
nodes.desc: Poultice Toss also poisons every enemy in its radius for 4 a second.
nodes.flavor: One fistful, two prescriptions.

root.name: Nine Fingers, Ten Opinions
root.flavor: Daro has a point. Daro always has a point. It's on a pole.

branches.name: Corporal
branches.blurb: Still a soldier under the scowl: sweeping the line clear, calling targets and making the squad hit harder.

nodes.name: Form Up
nodes.desc: Pike Sweep swings 30 degrees wider and reaches 6 px further.
nodes.flavor: Shaft level, feet set, mouth running.

nodes.name: Call the Target
nodes.desc: Pike Sweep marks what it hits: 25% more damage from everyone for 4 s.
nodes.flavor: "That one. No, the ugly one. The uglier one."

nodes.name: Hold the Ford
nodes.desc: Allies within 70 px of Daro deal 10% more damage.
nodes.flavor: Nobody wants to look slow in front of Daro. Daro will mention it.

nodes.name: Drill Voice
nodes.desc: Pike Sweep stuns for 0.8 s more and comes back 1.5 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: Learned on the parade ground. Unlearned nothing.

nodes.name: Orders Reversed
nodes.desc: Daro deals 30% more damage to marked enemies, and as an ally goes for marked enemies first.
nodes.flavor: They taught Daro to strike out villages. Daro strikes out Concord sergeants instead.

branches.name: Deserter
branches.blurb: Walked off the line and never looked back: light on their feet, never where you aimed, first blood every time.

nodes.name: Light Kit
nodes.desc: +6 Speed.
nodes.flavor: Left the regulation kit in a ditch near Tithe Road.

nodes.name: Not Here
nodes.desc: 12% of hits miss Daro completely.
nodes.flavor: Officially, Corporal Daro is not here. Officially, Corporal Daro is a pile of ash.

nodes.name: Run Them Through
nodes.desc: Long Thrust goes 20 px further, deals 6 more and comes back 1 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: The point goes in. The rest of Daro follows.

nodes.name: No Orders
nodes.desc: Daro deals 35% more damage to enemies that are still unhurt.
nodes.flavor: No orders means nobody says wait.

nodes.name: AWOL
nodes.desc: A kill by Daro resets Long Thrust at once, and 10% of their hits land half again as hard.
nodes.flavor: Gone before the paperwork. Gone before the body hits the ground.

root.name: Built Like a Door
root.flavor: Tobble says she was a big baby. Tobble says it quietly.

branches.name: Doorkeeper
branches.blurb: Nobody gets past the door: she pulls the room onto herself and keeps everyone behind her standing.

nodes.name: Coat Check
nodes.desc: Armor blocks 6% more of every hit.
nodes.flavor: Six tickets in her coat pocket. She never hands them in.

nodes.name: Nobody Gets Past
nodes.desc: Everything Last Orders hits goes for Ottoline for 3 s.
nodes.flavor: Every eye in the room on the bouncer. As it should be.

nodes.name: Door Policy
nodes.desc: Allies within 70 px of her take 10% less damage. As an ally she goes for whatever is attacking the leader.
nodes.flavor: Inside the door, you're hers. Outside, you're on your own.

nodes.name: Six Tickets
nodes.desc: Enemies that hit her take 25% of it back.
nodes.flavor: Hitting Ottoline is a mistake you make once, painfully.

nodes.name: Closing the Door
nodes.desc: Once a mission, a blow that would drop her leaves her on 1 HP instead. Last Orders comes back 3 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: She shut it once on six people. She will not be the one left outside.

branches.name: Brawler
branches.blurb: A bar fight with extra steps: stun them, then make them regret standing up.

nodes.name: Knuckle Duster
nodes.desc: +2 Damage.
nodes.flavor: Brass, polished nightly. Dented nightly.

nodes.name: One More Round
nodes.desc: Chucking Out goes 16 px further and comes back 1.5 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: Last orders were an hour ago. She's not counting.

nodes.name: Ringing Ears
nodes.desc: She deals 30% more damage to stunned enemies.
nodes.flavor: Hit them while the bells are still going.

nodes.name: Last Call
nodes.desc: Kills refill her gauge at once and heal her 3.
nodes.flavor: Next!

nodes.name: Lights Up
nodes.desc: Her full-power swings stun for 0.4 s, and Chucking Out stuns 0.6 s longer.
nodes.flavor: Lights up, music off, everybody out.

root.name: Light Fingers
root.flavor: Your purse was never safe. It was merely unvisited.

branches.name: After Dark
branches.blurb: Struck from the Ledger and better for it: longer in the dark, the first cut from nowhere, gone again.

nodes.name: Soft Soles
nodes.desc: Lamps Out lasts 1 s longer and loses enemies 30 px further away.
nodes.flavor: Never the creaky board. Never.

nodes.name: Back Alley
nodes.desc: She deals 30% more damage to enemies that are still unhurt.
nodes.flavor: The first cut is the one they never see.

nodes.name: Off the Books
nodes.desc: Lamps Out heals her 10 and comes back 3 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: A bandage in the dark, a wink in the light.

nodes.name: Struck from the Ledger
nodes.desc: 15% of hits miss her completely.
nodes.flavor: Hard to hit someone the world has stopped writing down.

nodes.name: Nobody's Name
nodes.desc: Every kill she lands puts her out of sight for 1.5 s, and Lamps Out's ambush hits half again as hard.
nodes.flavor: Occupation: yes. Whereabouts: no.

branches.name: Smuggler
branches.blurb: Contraband by the crate: more knives, nastier knives, and a cut of everything that falls.

nodes.name: Extra Blade
nodes.desc: Knife Fan throws one more knife.
nodes.flavor: There's always one more. Check her boots.

nodes.name: Weighted Hilts
nodes.desc: Knife Fan's knives deal 3 more and fly 30 px further.
nodes.flavor: Balanced in Saltreed, sold in Hollowmark, thrown everywhere.

nodes.name: Contraband
nodes.desc: Knife Fan's knives go through every enemy on their line and poison for 2 a second.
nodes.flavor: Never declared at customs. Never opened, either.

nodes.name: Hot Goods
nodes.desc: Every kill she lands is worth 2 Gilt (brought home with the loot) and 1 Ink.
nodes.flavor: Finders keepers, killers more so.

nodes.name: Knife Rain
nodes.desc: Knife Fan throws two more knives, costs 1 less Ink and comes back 1 s sooner. As an ally she picks off the wounded first.
nodes.flavor: It's not raining. Don't look up.

root.name: Double Entry
root.flavor: Every debit has a credit. Every Nibbler has a column.

branches.name: Assessor
branches.blurb: The fair assessor her mother never was: Levy pays the party back with interest.

nodes.name: Fair Share
nodes.desc: Levy can heal each ally 6 more and reaches allies 20 px further away.
nodes.flavor: Assessed fairly. Distributed fairly. Novel concept.

nodes.name: Rebate
nodes.desc: Levy also gives allies nearby a quarter of what it takes as Ink.
nodes.flavor: A rebate, for once, in the right direction.

nodes.name: Tax Relief
nodes.desc: Every heal she gives is 20% bigger, and Levy comes back 2 s sooner.
nodes.flavor: Relief is cheaper than funerals. She ran the numbers.

nodes.name: Sign Here
nodes.desc: Fallen allies near her get up 75% faster.
nodes.flavor: "You are not dead until I've stamped it."

nodes.name: Restitution
nodes.desc: Levy deals 6 more and reaches 20 px further, and every hit she lands heals her for 15% of it.
nodes.flavor: Penhallow Mere was saved with 90 stolen Gilt. She is paying it back in blood.

branches.name: Collector
branches.blurb: The Concord trained her to collect, and she was very good at it: audits that hurt and debts that come due.

nodes.name: Penalty Clause
nodes.desc: +2 Damage.
nodes.flavor: The ledger is iron-bound for a reason.

nodes.name: Itemised
nodes.desc: Audit reaches 20 px further and lasts 2 s longer.
nodes.flavor: Every line. Every column. Every Nibbler.

nodes.name: Late Fees
nodes.desc: She deals 25% more damage to marked enemies, and as an ally goes for marked enemies first.
nodes.flavor: Payment is overdue. Payment is always overdue.

nodes.name: Distraint
nodes.desc: Audit also deals 8 damage and stuns for 0.8 s.
nodes.flavor: Seizure of goods, and of the goods' owner.

nodes.name: Writ of Seizure
nodes.desc: Audited enemies take 15% more again, and every kill she lands pays 2 Gilt (brought home with the loot) and 3 Ink.
nodes.flavor: Countersigned. Not by her mother.

root.name: En Garde
root.flavor: The rapier is a long sentence with a full stop at the end.

branches.name: Duelist
branches.blurb: Precision, nothing wasted: wider parries, cleaner answers, and the killing thrust on anything that bleeds.

nodes.name: Tight Guard
nodes.desc: Riposte's guard holds 0.3 s longer.
nodes.flavor: She can wait. She has waited eleven bodies' worth.

nodes.name: Second Intention
nodes.desc: Riposte's answer deals 8 more and refunds 1 more Ink.
nodes.flavor: The first move is a lie. The second is the point.

nodes.name: Prise de Fer
nodes.desc: 15% of her hits land half again as hard.
nodes.flavor: Take the blade, take the opening, take the bow.

nodes.name: Killing Blow
nodes.desc: She deals 35% more damage to enemies under 35% HP, and as an ally picks off the wounded first.
nodes.flavor: The audience always knows when it is the last act.

nodes.name: Bind and Answer
nodes.desc: Riposte answers every enemy within its reach, not just the one that swung, and stuns 0.4 s longer.
nodes.flavor: One parry, every throat.

branches.name: Star
branches.blurb: She was the show before she was the weapon: lunges for the gallery and a stage presence that lifts everyone on it.

nodes.name: Stage Presence
nodes.desc: Fleche deals 5 more and lunges 16 px further.
nodes.flavor: Enter, stage left, at speed.

nodes.name: Applause
nodes.desc: Kills refill her gauge at once.
nodes.flavor: She bows. Briefly. There's another one.

nodes.name: Spotlight
nodes.desc: Allies within 70 px of her deal 10% more damage.
nodes.flavor: Everyone performs better with a star in the room. Everyone performs worse beside one.

nodes.name: Showstopper
nodes.desc: Fleche stuns for 0.6 s more and marks what it hits: 25% more damage from everyone for 4 s.
nodes.flavor: Hold the pose. Let them look.

nodes.name: Standing Ovation
nodes.desc: Every kill she lands gives 2 Ink to each ally within 90 px, and her charged techs hit 20% harder.
nodes.flavor: The Gilded Heron never had a house like this one.
